question: How much premium was unearned at 31 December 2024?
final_text:
Unearned premium at 31 December 2024 was about **£13.59m** (£13,585,360.18), gross of reinsurance.

I took every premium transaction booked on or before 31 Dec 2024 (197,118 rows, net written premium £106.49m). For each, I calculated the part of its cover period falling after 31 Dec 2024 and pro-rated the premium on that basis. Cancellation and mid-term adjustment rows are included, so the return premiums reduce the unearned balance. Earned to date is £92.90m, and the two figures reconcile to written premium. No rows had zero or negative cover length.

ANSWER: 13585360.18

input.query: SELECT txn_type, COUNT(*) n, SUM(written_premium) wp, SUM(exposure_units) eu, MIN(booked_date) mn, MAX(booked_date) mx, SUM(CASE WHEN booked_date<=DATE '2024-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_booked_2024 FROM premium_txn GROUP BY txn_type;
SELECT * FROM premium_txn WHERE txn_type='CANCEL' LIMIT 5;

WITH d AS (SELECT DATE '2024-12-31' AS D),
t AS (
  SELECT p.*, (p.cover_end_date - p.effective_date) AS len,
    GREATEST(p.cover_end_date - GREATEST(p.effective_date, DATE '2024-12-31'), 0) AS rem
  FROM premium_txn p WHERE p.booked_date <= DATE '2024-12-31'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN len<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) zero_len,
  SUM(CASE WHEN len>0 THEN written_premium*rem/len ELSE 0 END) AS unearned,
  SUM(written_premium) AS wp_booked,
  SUM(CASE WHEN len>0 THEN written_premium*(len-rem)/len ELSE written_premium END) AS earned_to_date
FROM t;
